name: marathon
description: A long-running development workflow run as a software factory: goals and tasks in a roadmap manifest, with active, planned, and backlog states and a repository lock so goals run side by side; one goal record per active goal; a plan, build, brief, and ship pipeline in which the architect approves the task brief and accepts the session brief; every session landing through a pull request, and release tags cut at ship once main is green; planner, implementer, standards-reviewer, spec-reviewer, and editor agent profiles; checks first; an optional currency command that plan runs before its first round, so a task begins by upgrading what trails; init, plan, start, experiment, intake, status, retro, and reset commands; experiments whose spikes are sub-goals homed in their own repositories, run in parallel, and taken in by intake; extension hooks; and a flat context/ of notes that state what exists or what is planned
